subject.title: fix(discord): retry reply session init conflicts to prevent silent message loss

question: Should reply-session initialization conflict recovery remain channel-local for Discord, or should the shared recovery proposed by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920 own this behavior across channels?
rationale: Both implementations address the same root cause at different ownership layers, and source inspection cannot determine whether maintainers want layered recovery or one canonical retry policy.

options.title: Land the Discord retry
options.body: Keep this bounded channel-level recovery, verify it composes with shared session behavior, and require live Discord proof before merge.

options.title: Use shared recovery only
options.body: Pause this PR and make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920 cover Discord with equivalent delivery and cancellation proof.

recommendation.title: Land the Discord retry
recommendation.body: Keep this bounded channel-level recovery, verify it composes with shared session behavior, and require live Discord proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The closest merged precedent is the Slack channel-level retry authored by this contributor, making them the strongest available routing candidate for the ownership choice.
